realm.match: Match each queen to her realm.
realm.reverse: Which of these women was queen of {value}?

rows.label: Elizabeth II
rows.description: Queen of the United Kingdom from 1952 to 2022 (1926–2022)
rows.hook: reigned longer than any other British monarch, for over seventy years

rows.label: Victoria
rows.description: Queen of the United Kingdom from 1837 to 1901 (1819-1901)
rows.hook: gave her name to an era of industry and empire and ruled for over sixty years

rows.label: Cleopatra
rows.description: Queen of Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt from 51 to 30 BCE
rows.hook: was the last active ruler of her dynasty and allied with two famous Roman leaders

rows.label: Anne Boleyn
rows.description: second wife of Henry VIII of England (died 1536)
rows.hook: was beheaded after the king broke with Rome to marry her

rows.label: Marie Antoinette
rows.description: last Queen of France prior to the French Revolution (1755–1793)
rows.hook: is the French royal falsely said to have told hungry crowds to eat cake

rows.label: Mary I
rows.description: Queen of England and Ireland from 1553 to 1558 (1516-1558)
rows.hook: earned the grim nickname "Bloody" for burning religious dissenters at the stake

rows.label: Mary, Queen of Scots
rows.description: Queen of Scotland from 1542 to 1567 (1542–1587)
rows.hook: was held captive by her cousin for years before being beheaded

rows.label: Catherine of Aragon
rows.description: first wife of Henry VIII of England (1485–1536)
rows.hook: refused to accept the annulment of her marriage, which led the king to break with Rome

rows.label: Lady Jane Grey
rows.description: Queen of England and Ireland in July 1553
rows.hook: held the crown for just nine days before being deposed and beheaded

rows.label: Queen Camilla
rows.description: Queen consort of the United Kingdom since 2022
rows.hook: married the heir to the throne after a long, highly publicised relationship

rows.label: Mary of Teck
rows.description: Queen consort of the United Kingdom from 1910 to 1936

rows.label: Catherine Howard
rows.description: fifth wife of Henry VIII of England
rows.hook: was a teenage bride of the king who was beheaded over her past entanglements

rows.label: Jane Seymour
rows.description: third wife of Henry VIII of England
rows.hook: gave the king his long-awaited male heir but died soon after the birth

rows.label: Queen Elizabeth the Queen Mother
rows.description: Queen consort of the United Kingdom from 1936 to 1952 (1900–2002)
rows.hook: was a beloved, long-lived royal famed for boosting morale during the Blitz

rows.label: Catherine Parr
rows.description: sixth wife of Henry VIII of England; final queen consort of the House of Tudor

rows.label: Anne of Cleves
rows.description: Queen consort of England (1515–1557)

rows.label: Charlotte of Mecklenburg-Strelitz
rows.description: Queen consort of Great Britain and Ireland from 1761 to 1818
rows.hook: was the long-serving consort of the king who lost the American colonies

rows.label: Alexandra of Denmark
rows.description: Queen consort of the United Kingdom from 1901 to 1910

rows.label: Joséphine de Beauharnais
rows.description: Empress consort of the French from 1804 to 1814 (1763-1814)
rows.hook: was the first wife of a famous French emperor, who annulled the marriage

rows.label: Catherine de' Medici
rows.description: queen-consort and regent of France (1519–1589)
rows.hook: was a Florentine-born royal who mothered three kings and wielded great influence

rows.label: Nefertiti
rows.description: Egyptian queen and Great Royal Wife (chief consort) of Akhenaten, an Egyptian Pharaoh
rows.hook: is remembered through a famous painted bust and a sun-worshipping revolution

rows.label: Wu Zetian
rows.description: founding empress of Zhou dynasty (r. 690–705); de facto ruler of Tang dynasty from 665 to 690

rows.label: Hatshepsut
rows.description: 5th Pharaoh of the Eighteenth Dynasty of Egypt (c. 1479 BC - 1458 BC)
rows.hook: ruled as a female pharaoh, often shown wearing a ceremonial false beard

rows.label: Liliʻuokalani
rows.description: monarch of the Hawaiian Kingdom (1838–1917)

rows.label: Ranavalona I
rows.description: queen of Imerina (1828-1861)

rows.label: Caroline of Brunswick
rows.description: Queen consort of the United Kingdom and Hanover from 1820 to 1821
